create_class_Mxfp4Config: create an Mxfp4Config instance to configure MXFP4 quantization for MoE layers
create_class_Mxfp4MoEMethod: create an Mxfp4MoEMethod to handle pre-quantized MXFP4 weights in fused MoE layers
create_class_Mxfp4DynamicQuantMoEMethod: create a Mxfp4DynamicQuantMoEMethod for dynamic runtime MXFP4 quantization of MoE weights
run_function_dequant_mxfp4: run dequant_mxfp4 to dequantize MXFP4 tensor data back to float dtype using amd-quark
run_function_quant_dequant_mxfp4: run quant_dequant_mxfp4 to quantize and dequantize a tensor using MXFP4 format
